game: Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow & the Flame
approach: Native Windows port with gameplay logic recovered from the original Macintosh 68k executable, original game resources, and quality-of-life improvements.
notes: Levels 1 and 2 have playable routes. Level 3 gameplay is under active development, with scenery recovered for all 32 rooms. Original game resources are required and are not bundled. No Macintosh emulator is needed to play.
